title: MCP Server
description: A registration for a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. MCP server entities are referenced from agent manifest tool resources (type 'mcp-server-entity') and resolved into MCP tools at runtime. Resolution keys off the mcp-server entity's name (its final name component under a searched prefix), not the 'serverName' field: the tool resource 'name' is appended to each search prefix (machine profile, then '${USER}/mcp-servers', then 'defaults/mcp-servers') and the first existing entity with an 'mcp-server' property wins. Storing servers as entities lets different machines and users register different servers (for example, machine-specific stdio commands) under the same logical name.

serverName.description: The logical name of the MCP server (e.g., 'github'). Used for discovery listings and to name the resulting MCP tool; it is NOT the manifest-resolution key. Manifest tool resources resolve an mcp-server entity by its entity name under a searched prefix, not by this field.

serverDescription.description: Human-readable description of the MCP server and the tools it provides.

description.description: Optional description used when the server is surfaced as a tool.

connection.description: MCP server connection. Discriminated by 'kind'. Only the Anonymous, key, and oauth kinds are supported at runtime; any other kind is rejected with an "unsupported connection type" error.

endpoint.description: http(s):// MCP URL, or stdio://?command=<exe>&arg=<a>&cwd=<dir> for a local process.
http(s):// MCP URL (stdio:// with an apiKey is rejected at runtime).

apiKey.description: Bearer token. '${ENV_VAR}' reads an environment variable and a literal value is used as-is. '${SECRET:Name}' is resolved via the secret store (rewritten to an opaque secret handle during agent-definition materialization, which triggers the secret-consent dialog). Special-case '${GITHUB_TOKEN}' falls back to gh auth token.

endpoint.description: http(s):// MCP resource endpoint. OAuth metadata is discovered from it (RFC 9728/8414).

clientId.description: Optional OAuth client id. Omit to use dynamic client registration (RFC 7591). '${ENV_VAR}' reads an environment variable, a literal value is used as-is, and '${SECRET:Name}' is resolved via the secret-aware resolver (secret store).

clientSecret.description: Optional OAuth client secret. Omit for a public client (PKCE). '${ENV_VAR}' reads an environment variable, a literal value is used as-is, and '${SECRET:Name}' is resolved via the secret-aware resolver (secret store).

tokenUrl.description: Optional explicit OAuth token endpoint; normally discovered automatically from 'endpoint'.

authenticationMode.description: Optional OAuth authentication mode. Defaults to 'system'.

approvalMode.description: Tool-call approval policy for this server. Mirrors the agent tool approvalMode (kinds: 'always', 'never', 'specify').

alwaysRequireApprovalTools.description: When kind is 'specify', the tool names that always require approval.

neverRequireApprovalTools.description: When kind is 'specify', the tool names that never require approval.

allowedTools.description: Optional allow-list of tool names exposed by the server. When omitted, all tools are available.
